definitions.label: Heat spell: hotter than usual for this place and time of year, and hot enough to matter
Unusually warm for this place and time of year, at any temperature (relevant to snow and glacier melt, not a heat-stress measure)
Cold spell: colder than usual for this place and time of year, and cold enough to matter
Heavy snow: 3-day snowfall ≥ 30 cm (screening, not verified: against 35 snow stations the model snowfall caught 12% of 30 cm events)
Rain on snow above 1,500 m: ≥ 5 mm rain with ≥ 5 cm of snow from the previous 5 days still lying, max above 2 °C (screening, not verified against the station record)

thresholds.label: Heavy snow: ≥ 10 cm in a day (screening, not verified: model snowfall caught 25% of such days at the snow stations)
